title: 6 The Courtyard, Baltimore, Co. Cork, P81V578

description:
6 The Courtyard is an end-of-terrace 4 bed residence in a small, mature estate in Baltimore village, one of West Cork's best known sailing and harbour villages. 

Set to the rear of the development and well back from the main road, it enjoys a quiet, private position while remaining within easy walking distance of the harbour, the village shop, restaurants and pubs.

The house measures approximately 120 sqm and offers well-proportioned accommodation over two floors. A ground floor bedroom with en suite adds useful flexibility, working equally well as a second sitting room.

There is a private garden to the rear and parking to the front.

Baltimore is built around its harbour, with a strong sailing tradition and ferry connections to Sherkin Island and Cape Clear. Village life, from the shop to the restaurants and pubs, is all within easy reach on foot.
